items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Like Ernie Watts says, “The notes go up, the notes go down.”

ctx.x: Yeah, because that’s a hard instrument to learn the other way after you do the saxophone it seems like.
Yeah, well saxophone comes easy see? I mean you know it’s just up and down. Like Ernie Watts says, “The notes go up, the notes go down.”
It’s just like a piano. One is right next to the other one.
